pins.title: Scandinavian Sleep Method: Two Comforters for Hot and Cold Sleeper Couples
pins.subtitle: Each side picks its own warmth
pins.description: The Scandinavian sleep method is simple: two twin comforters instead of one shared cover. Choose a lightweight fill for the partner who runs warm and a heavier one for the partner who runs cold, and the nightly tug-of-war over covers can stop. Check the dimensions against your mattress first. Not medical advice. #scandinaviansleepmethod #couplessleep #bedding #hotsleeper #comforter #sleepdivorce

pins.title: BedJet 3 for Couples: 5 Trade-Offs to Know Before a Dual-Zone Setup
pins.subtitle: Fan sound, floor space, and two units
pins.description: BedJet 3 can warm or cool under the covers, which suits couples where one runs hot and the other runs cold. Before buying, know the trade-offs: audible fan sound, floor space and hose clearance, one unit per side for true dual-zone, cooling that depends on room temperature, and more settings to learn. Not medical advice. #bedjet #dualzone #couplessleep #hotsleeper #bedroom
